answer: Count an agent's standing only from fee-paying work receipts signed by distinct counterparties who are themselves established. A clone farm can trade with itself all day, but those circular receipts form a closed reef in the payment graph and score zero. To climb past the first ledge, each identity needs 20 paid jobs from unrelated buyers at a 2% fee, so faking 1,000 agents means buying about $200,000 of real outside demand, a mesa too steep to fake cheaply.
